title: The Price of Thinking: Reasoning Effort as a Model-Specific API Contract
description:
arXiv:2608.16956v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: API buyers purchase a dated contract, not a model name alone: the contract includes the requested and served model, reasoning-effort term or its omission, output rail, service product, prompt, and price schedule. We study the reasoning-effort term through a registered paired contrast of Sonnet 5 with explicit high effort against the same model with effort omitted, using 30 AIME 2026 items and five calls per item.
